terminal_objects.source_locator: BE-AGH-2026-BSW-WAHLPROGRAMM, physical PDF page 14 of 66, normalized source unit 2, effect atom 2 of 3
terminal_objects.source_excerpt: Wir wollen eine Rückbesinnung auf verbindliche Inhalte, klare Leistungsstandards und überprüfbare Ergebnisse.
terminal_objects.policy: verbindliche Inhalte, klare Leistungsstandards, überprüfbare Ergebnisse
terminal_objects.mechanism: Clearer curriculum/expectations and feedback can improve instructional coherence and transparency; excessive standardisation/high-stakes measurement can narrow curriculum, induce teaching-to-test and disadvantage heterogeneous learning needs.
terminal_objects.distribution: Effects can differ by language background, disability/SEN, school resources and parental support.
material_risks: inequitable consequences if standards are not paired with support
terminal_objects.reality_check: Learning progress across domains, inequality gaps, student wellbeing, repetition/dropout and teacher workload; test scores alone are insufficient.
terminal_objects.competence: Primarily Berlin school/curriculum/quality governance, subject to constitutional/equal-treatment/inclusion requirements.

terminal_objects.source_excerpt: Das BSW Berlin fordert deshalb eine verpflichtende Teilnahme an der Kita spätestens ab dem vierten Lebensjahr.
terminal_objects.policy: mandatory Kita attendance no later than age four
terminal_objects.mechanism: Earlier/common participation can increase access to language, social and cognitive support and reduce unequal starting conditions.
terminal_objects.noncompensation_guard: Participation quantity cannot compensate for low process quality, safeguarding or inclusion.
terminal_objects.reality_check: Actual participation of previously underreached groups, process quality/staff ratios, language/development trajectories, exclusions/exemptions, family burden and later school-entry gaps.
terminal_objects.required_safeguard: Capacity first; transparent exemptions/accommodations and accessible high-quality provision.

terminal_objects.source_locator: BE-AGH-2026-BSW-WAHLPROGRAMM, physical PDF page 14 of 66, normalized source unit 4, effect atom 3 of 3
terminal_objects.source_excerpt: So können sprachliche, soziale und kognitive Kompetenzen frühzeitig gefördert werden.
terminal_objects.classification_rationale: claimed mechanism/outcome rationale child of U04-A02, not separate action

terminal_objects.source_locator: BE-AGH-2026-BSW-WAHLPROGRAMM, physical PDF page 14 of 66, normalized source unit 5, effect atom 1 of 2
terminal_objects.source_excerpt: Zur Sicherung der Bildungsqualität in den Kitas sollen regelmäßige Sprachdiagnostiken ab dem dritten Lebensjahr eingeführt werden.
terminal_objects.policy: regular language diagnostics from age three
terminal_objects.mechanism: Earlier identification can trigger timely language support before school entry.
terminal_objects.reality_check: Diagnostic validity across languages, referral-to-support completion, waiting time, subsequent language development and false-positive/negative rates.
terminal_objects.required_safeguard: Diagnostics are useful only if linked to qualified support and do not become exclusion/selection proxies.

terminal_objects.source_locator: BE-AGH-2026-BSW-WAHLPROGRAMM, physical PDF page 14 of 66, normalized source unit 5, effect atom 2 of 2
terminal_objects.source_excerpt: Ergänzend sollen Stadtteilmütter und Integrationslotsen als Vermittler zwischen Familien, Kitas und Schulen wirken und Eltern stärker in die frühkindliche Förderung einbeziehen.
terminal_objects.policy: Stadtteilmütter/Integrationslotsen mediate family–Kita–school relationships and strengthen parental involvement
terminal_objects.mechanism: Trusted outreach can reduce information/language/institutional barriers and improve take-up/continuity of support.
terminal_objects.distribution: Potentially strongest for families facing language, trust, poverty or navigation barriers.
terminal_objects.reality_check: Reach of previously underreached families, successful referrals, sustained participation, family trust and child-support continuity; contact counts alone are output.

terminal_objects.source_locator: BE-AGH-2026-BSW-WAHLPROGRAMM, physical PDF page 14 of 66, normalized source unit 6, effect atom 1 of 2
terminal_objects.source_excerpt: Darüber hinaus setzen wir uns für die Wiedereinführung einer verbindlichen Vorschulphase ein, die gezielt Sprachbildung, Zahlenverständnis und soziales Lernen fördert.
terminal_objects.policy: reintroduce a binding preschool phase focused on language, numeracy and social learning
terminal_objects.mechanism: Structured preparation can reduce school-entry skill gaps if high quality and targeted to actual needs.
terminal_objects.reality_check: School-entry competencies, distribution gaps, attendance/reach, quality, staff burden and transition continuity.

terminal_objects.source_excerpt: Das BSW Berlin fordert ein mehrjähriges Förderprogramm für Schulen in Brennpunktlagen, das zusätzliche Mittel, Fortbildungen und voll ausgebildetes Personal bereitstellt.
terminal_objects.policy: multi-year support programme for schools in disadvantaged locations with additional funds, training and fully qualified staff
terminal_objects.mechanism: Additional targeted resources and staff capacity can improve learning/support conditions where need is concentrated.
terminal_objects.key_condition: Genuine additionality and needs-based allocation; funding alone is input.
material_risks: resource displacement from other high-need schools
terminal_objects.reality_check: Qualified staffing/retention, instructional/support quality, learning and participation gaps, absenteeism, school climate and distribution by need over multiple years.

terminal_objects.source_locator: BE-AGH-2026-BSW-WAHLPROGRAMM, physical PDF page 14 of 66, normalized source unit 9, effect atom 1 of 4
terminal_objects.source_excerpt: Darüber hinaus soll durch Verteilungsquoten beim Übergang in die Grundschulen eine bessere Durchmischung von Schülern mit unterschiedlichem deutschen Sprachstand innerhalb der Bezirke erreicht werden.
terminal_objects.policy: distribution quotas at transition to primary school based on differing German-language proficiency within districts
terminal_objects.mechanism: Reducing concentration of language-support needs may improve peer mixing and distribute support demands more evenly.
material_risks: displacement rather than improvement of school quality
terminal_objects.protected_interest_guard: Language proficiency must not become an ethnic/origin proxy; transparent lawful criteria, proportionality, accommodations and appeal are material.
terminal_objects.reality_check: Segregation indices, travel distances, family burden, allocation/appeal outcomes, school-level support resources and learning/integration outcomes.

terminal_objects.source_locator: BE-AGH-2026-BSW-WAHLPROGRAMM, physical PDF page 14 of 66, normalized source unit 9, effect atom 2 of 4
terminal_objects.source_excerpt: Ziel ist es, Segregation zu verhindern und Begegnung zu fördern.

terminal_objects.source_excerpt: Schüler nicht deutscher Herkunft sollen durch diese Maßnahme gleichmäßiger auf die Klassen im Bezirk verteilt werden.
terminal_objects.policy: students ‘nicht deutscher Herkunft’ distributed more evenly across classes in the district
terminal_objects.distinct_boundary: This is not treated as a harmless duplicate of U09-A01 because the criterion changes from language proficiency to origin.
material_risks: origin-based allocation can create unequal treatment/stigmatisation
origin is not equivalent to measured language-support need

terminal_objects.reality_check: Actual allocation criterion, equal-treatment/legal review, appeals, distribution/travel effects and educational outcomes.

terminal_objects.source_locator: BE-AGH-2026-BSW-WAHLPROGRAMM, physical PDF page 14 of 66, normalized source unit 9, effect atom 4 of 4
terminal_objects.source_excerpt: Wir streben die bessere Integration der Schulen in ihre Stadtteile an, um Schule, Kultur, Nachbarschaft und soziale Dienste miteinander zu verbinden uns so Ankerpunkte lokaler Gemeinschaften zu schaffen.
terminal_objects.policy: integrate schools more strongly into neighbourhoods, linking school, culture, neighbourhood and social services
terminal_objects.mechanism: Easier referrals/shared spaces/relationships can reduce institutional fragmentation and improve access to support/community resources.
material_risks: substitution of school resources for wider social-service deficits
terminal_objects.reality_check: Completed referrals/support access, participation of vulnerable groups, school staff workload, continuity of services and neighbourhood disparities; number of partnerships alone is output.
